# BNBTiger / COOKIE candidates — NOT QUALIFIED

These two direct-mapping candidates sit outside the immutable historical 431 and
qualified 425 cohorts. `layouts.json` contains only the two exact template-bound
profiles; individual NOT-QUALIFIED files are the corresponding one-profile arrays.
`source-review.json` pins the final Phase A captures, compiler outputs, primary and
writer records, notices/licenses and reports. No historical fixture is edited.

Packed fields require canonical old/new values, unchanged pinned constructor
constants and zero padding. Unknown or constructor-only persisted records, including
no-ops, refuse under these two modes. Getter independence alone never grants a
whole-word permission. See [the candidate contract](../../../docs/bnbtiger-cookie-candidates.md)
and [the original proof](../../../docs/bnbtiger-cookie-getter-proof.md).

Saved replay and final qualification status are recorded in the candidate document;
these files do not establish current deployed runtime, producer, package or global
holder support.
